id: title:amays-phog:exclude mocked tests from usage records

review.posthog_relevance: Billing and subscription tier enforcement for HogFlow execution, distinguishing between production and mocked test environments.
review.reason: The change adds a conditional check to prevent billing invocation in unmocked production and mocked test environments, while expanding billing type coverage. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in billing correctness and reliability, distinguishing between production and test execution contexts.
review.uncertainty: The actual impact of this billing change on PostHog's revenue or customer experience is not demonstrated by the code alone; the benefit is inferred from the implementation rather than observed outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only test and implementation changes. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional check before billing invocation and expands the billing type coverage.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks whether HogFlow billing should be recorded, excluding unmocked production and mocked test environments.
